categories.main_business_segments: 3onedata Co., Ltd. primarily operates in industrial internet communication solutions, focusing on industrial Ethernet switches, embedded industrial Ethernet modules, device networking products, and industrial wireless products. The company serves multiple sectors including smart energy, smart transportation, industrial internet, smart cities, and intelligent manufacturing, providing comprehensive end-to-end industrial internet communication solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary core technologies such as the SWOSA9 industrial switch platform, NOS industrial switch operating system, modular product technology, BlueEdge industrial gateway digital application platform, and TSN (Time Sensitive Network) technology. It employs a combination of in-house production and outsourced PCB assembly, with strict R&D processes including IPD product development and extensive patent holdings. The company also integrates AI, edge computing, 5G, WiFi7, and industrial security technologies in its products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading enterprises in power and new energy, smart mining, rail transit, digital cities, and intelligent manufacturing. The company has established strong relationships with major clients such as China CRRC, China Coal Technology, and State Grid. Its products and solutions cater to industrial automation, energy management, transportation infrastructure, and smart city projects domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a strong domestic presence in 21 core cities including Shenzhen, Beijing, and Shanghai. It also actively expands overseas markets through localized sales and service teams, with business in over 30 countries and regions including Europe, Oceania, Southeast Asia, and Eastern Europe via subsidiaries and partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: 3onedata operates mainly in the midstream segment of the industrial internet communication supply chain, focusing on R&D, design, and manufacturing of communication hardware and software solutions. It procures key components such as chips and optical devices from suppliers, manages production including core assembly in-house and outsourcing PCB assembly, and delivers integrated solutions to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in industrial communication, TSN, HaaS (Hardware as a Service), industrial AI, 6G, and industrial control technologies. It invests heavily in R&D (over 20% of revenue), actively participates in industry standard setting, and pursues integration of AI models like DeepSeek for intelligent edge computing. Strategic initiatives include expanding solution capabilities, enhancing product modularity, and deepening market penetration in core and emerging sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of industrial communication products including switches, gateways, wireless devices, and customized solutions. The company employs a mixed sales model with direct sales dominating domestically and a combination of direct sales and local agents overseas. It also earns income from providing integrated industrial internet solutions and related technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: 3onedata is positioned as a leading domestic provider of industrial internet communication solutions with strong brand recognition and technological capabilities. It competes with both domestic and international industrial communication equipment manufacturers, leveraging its proprietary technologies, multi-industry application expertise, and comprehensive solution offerings to maintain a leading market share in smart energy, smart mining, rail transit, and smart city sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 356.8 million, a decrease of 18.79% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 32.8 million, down 69.98%. Despite revenue decline due to macroeconomic and market factors, the company increased R&D investment by 19.56% to RMB 73.5 million, representing 20.59% of revenue. It maintains a solid asset base with total assets around RMB 1 billion and continues to expand cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: 3onedata emphasizes its comprehensive, self-developed industrial internet communication technology stack, including high reliability, real-time performance, and security tailored for industrial environments. Its unique value lies in providing end-to-end digital infrastructure solutions with strong customization capabilities, integration of AI and edge computing, and adherence to industry standards. The company’s products support critical industrial applications with robust performance in harsh conditions, enhancing customer operational efficiency and digital transformation.
